style: Single isolated high-quality sound-design element. Immediate action and short decay. Clean dry close recording, no background ambience or music.

sounds.prompt: One fast polished card-game movement: a narrow textured air sweep with a dry papery edge, accelerating quickly then cutting cleanly. Close, crisp, restrained, with no landing impact. A physical card moving with confident weight. No shimmering, musical note, electronic sweep, or long tail.

One compact card-game landing: a clean papery snap over a small dense leather-and-wood knock. Firm but not heavy, close and sharply damped. One immediate contact, then silence. No bass boom, magical sparkle, ring or springy toy sound.

One crisp paired card reveal: two tightly synchronized dry papery flicks opening into a very short clean breath of air, with a tiny focused low-mid snap. Controlled tactile digital card-game feedback. No chimes, sci-fi synth, fluttering repetitions or echo.

One sharply defined martial-arts strike contact: a punchy leather focus-pad crack, short cloth snap and tiny upper-mid slap, instantly damped. The sharp front edge of a satisfying stylized combat hit. One hit only. No voice, ring, gunshot or electronic effect.

One short solid low-mid padded combat thud, like a powerful kick landing squarely on a thick tightly held training shield. Dense rounded body with fast attack and no flapping. This is the body layer beneath a sharper strike sound. No added sub-bass explosion, resonant tone, voice or reverberation.

One forceful glancing martial-arts parry: a compact hard padded knock followed immediately by a short diagonal rough cloth-and-air scrape moving aside. Distinct from a landed body punch; taut deflection and resistance. One block only. No sword clang, bell, wooden stick, synth or sparkling tail.

One purposeful stylized card burn: a tight dry ignition snap followed by a fast textured paper-and-flame sweep and a few small dying embers. Restrained, tactile, concise, immediately legible as consuming a card. No magical bells, electronic riser, explosion, musical tone or long reverb.
